brief:
Israeli forces and settlers carried out 1,840 violations in the West Bank between August 14 and 20, according to the Palestine Information Center – Ma'ateh, Shehab Wire reported. The tally encompasses infractions documented across the occupied territory during the seven-day monitoring period.

The Palestine Information Center – Ma'ateh regularly tracks violations by Israeli military forces and settler groups operating in Palestinian areas. The violations recorded during mid-August included a range of incidents across the West Bank. The center's documentation effort aims to create a detailed record of activities affecting Palestinian civilians and communities under Israeli control.
